components.title: eval-gate
components.description: Pre-promotion evaluation gate that runs an agent version against a fixed test set (prompt-injection resistance, data-leakage checks, output quality) and blocks promotion of any version that fails, giving the agent the accuracy and robustness assurance a high-risk AI system requires.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: An agent version promotes only after passing the fixed evaluation suite within the gate's failure budget.

props.name: Check_Description
props.value: fabric eval-gate runs an agent version's evaluation results through the promotion gate and records whether the version was cleared to ship.

control-implementations.description: Pre-promotion evaluation gating for AI agents in the pharma MES baseline.

implemented-requirements.description: The evaluation gate holds each agent version to a fixed accuracy and robustness test set and blocks promotion of any version that does not meet it.
